This tactile push button switch module operates through a simple mechanical principle: apply pressure to activate the switch, establishing a connection, and release to return it to its open state. The internal mechanism utilizes the dynamic force changes of a metal dome to reliably achieve both open and closed circuit conditions. Typically, pins 1 and 2, and pins 3 and 4 are connected when the button is at rest. When pressed, all four pins establish a connection, and upon release, the button reverts to its original configuration. When properly powered, a red LED illuminates to indicate active power. Pressing the button causes the module to output a low signal, simultaneously lighting up a blue LED. Releasing the button switches the output to a high signal and turns off the blue LED, providing clear visual and electrical feedback for its state. LILYGO is a technology company that specialises in developing, manufacturing and distributing IoT (Internet of Things) products. It is renowned for its versatile development boards, which are widely used in applications such as remote monitoring, smart metering and wearable devices. LILYGO openly shares documentation and sample code with the open-source community to support developers worldwide.

The reComputer Mini J501 carrier board is an ultra-compact carrier board designed for the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin™ modules, supporting both the 32GB and 64GB versions. Despite its small footprint, it provides a rich set of I/O interfaces, including CAN, USB, Ethernet, RS-485, and I2S, making it an excellent choice for humanoid robot controllers, embedded systems, and rapid prototyping. When paired with a Jetson AGX Orin™ module, the reComputer Mini J501 serves as a highly capable and cost-effective alternative to the NVIDIA® Jetson AGX Orin™ Developer Kit, offering strong performance, flexible integration, and a compact design optimized for production-ready applications. Features Powerful Embodied AI Platform: Fully compatible with the Jetson AGX Orin module, delivering up to 275 TOPS of AI performance. It is the perfect platform for embodied AI development and edge computing. Ultra-Compact Form Factor: Features a tiny 110mm x 110mm footprint, making it ideal for robot prototyping and deployment in space-constrained environments, such as humanoid robots. Wide Voltage Input Range: Supports a broad power input, making it compatible with 48V battery systems (up to 54V max input) for mobile robotics. Rich I/O Capabilities: Equipped with essential industrial interfaces including USB 3.2, 10G Ethernet, Dual CAN (CAN-FD), RS-485, and I2S for comprehensive connectivity. Arduino is a powerful open-source electronics platform that enables users to create interactive projects easily. Designed for beginners and experts alike, it features various microcontroller boards, such as the Arduino Uno and Mega, along with an intuitive IDE supporting simplified programming. The platform is ideal for applications in education, robotics, IoT, and home automation. Its active community offers extensive resources, tutorials, and project ideas, fostering creativity and innovation in electronics and programming.

KeyeStudio is a brand dedicated to hardware and software development, offering innovative electronic components, development boards, and sensors for both hobbyists and professionals. Their products are commonly utilized in IoT, robotics, and smart home technologies, along with comprehensive tutorials and support to improve the user experience.

The KeyeStudio USB Host v1.5 shield is an expansion module designed for Arduino boards to enable USB Host capabilities. Simply attach it to your Arduino, and it will allow communication with USB peripherals like flash drives, keyboards, mice, game controllers, and digital cameras. One of its standout features is the ability to connect Android smartphones, unlocking Google ADK functionality. This allows your mobile device to act as a control interface for robots or other hardware, while also displaying sensor or system data directly on your phone. The RS485 Shield for Arduino is a reliable communication expansion board designed specifically for the Arduino Uno and compatible boards. This Arduino RS485 shield enables UART-to-RS485 conversion, allowing your Arduino to communicate with industrial RS485 devices over long distances. With this UART to RS485 module, you get high anti-interference performance and stable data transmission for Modbus Arduino projects. Built with standard and mini RS485 ports, RS485 headers, and a flexible welding area, this RS485 shield for Arduino offers convenience and adaptability for both standard applications and custom DIY designs. With a switchable automatic/manual transmission mode, users can fine-tune their Arduino RS485 communication control based on specific system requirements.
